titleStmt.title: Cantata ved den nye Slots-Kirkes Solenne Indvielse

work.title: Cantata ved den nye Slots-Kirkes Solenne Indvielse

history.p: Only the text book seems to have survived. The cantata, which was composed for the inauguration of the newly finished Christiansborg Slotskirke on 27 November 1740, was Scheibe’s first official work for the Danish court. There must have been a close collaboration between Peder Sparkiær, who was the text author, and Scheibe when he arrived in Copenhagen sometime in October. In a letter, which he wrote to his acquaintance Johann Christoph Gottsched before the celebrations started, Scheibe mentions that 'the forthcoming birthdays [SchW B2:400, B2:402] and the inauguration of the new palace [SchW B2:407] will be celebrated with the greatest splendour and, as I ‒ through my employment ‒ have also been given the liberty to arrange everything according to my wishes, I will apply all my diligence so that both music as well as poetry will gain a different reputation than they have had for some time in these lands.' According to the newspaper, Extraordinaire Relationer, delightful music was played both before and after the sermon which was held by Peder Hersleb, with more than 60 performers of which quite a few were foreigners engaged for the event. The title page of the libretto mentions Scheibe as Kapellmeister though officially he did not receive his contract of employment until 1 December.

annot.p: 'Die bevorstehenden Geburtstage [SchW B2:400, B2:402] und die Einweÿhung des neuen Schloßes [SchW B2:407] werden mit der grösten Pracht begangen werden, und da ich zugleich durch meine Bedienung alle Freÿheit erhalte, alles nach meinem Gutbefinden anzuordnen, so werde allen Fleiß anwenden, daß so wohl die Music als die Poesie ein anderes Ansehn gewinnen, als sie einige Zeit in diesen Ländern gehabt haben.'

incipText.p: Hosianna! Lovet være Den, som kommer i HErrens Navn!
Med denne Bøn og Tak Hvers Hierte bryder ud
Vi vil hernæst i Bøn vedblive
Saa gaae vi da ad Dine Porte ind med Glæde
Saa er Indvielsen i JEsu Navn fuldendt
Din Lov vi vil da ey forglemme
